description: The course reversal flown where a procedure's path turns `turn_deg` at a fix (AIM 5-4-9): "coded" -- the chart's hold in lieu of a procedure turn or its procedure turn there, entered -- where one is coded at the fix and the path turns more than 90° there, come to from its far side (from the near side a pilot is lined up already and makes none, as on a NoPT route, 14 CFR 91.175(j)); else "teardrop" where the path doubles back more than 120° at a fix past the procedure's first; else null.
